sum: Semantic code search backed by a language server, served over MCP. A tool for avoiding whole-repository injection.

evidence.co.standards: cites standards_conformance.evidence: conforms to 2 of the 5 neutral interface standards (MCP, AGENTS.md)

evidence.se.threats: cites th and ctrl: T2/T17 introduced, controls allowlist part, prov none
evidence.sf.reach: restates exec and ctrl: the entry executes, and its reach is bounded by allowlist part
evidence.fx.exit: artifact.format ephemeral-path: a path that exists for the run; nothing durable survives it
evidence.pe.budget: a ceiling the operator sets on the command line: src/serena/cli.py (--timeout)
evidence.co.coexist: states the hosts it sits beside: Claude Code, Codex CLI, OpenCode, Cursor, JetBrains, GitHub Copilot, Cline, Windsurf, OpenAI Codex (README.md)
evidence.ic.help: a command-line parser that prints its own usage: src/serena/cli.py (click)
evidence.ic.error: a dry run the operator can ask for before the real one: src/serena/cli.py (--dry-run)
evidence.rl.resume: recovering is described in prose, not implemented: docs/02-usage/050_configuration.md (rollback)
evidence.fx.install: an install that does not change the machine globally: README.md (uv tool install)
evidence.fx.byo: the provider is the operator's choice: BASEURL (docs/_config.yml)
evidence.sf.warn: the irreversible step is both warned about and gated: docs/02-usage/030_clients.md (destructive)
